name: xoffense
description: xOffense autonomous pentest framework (arXiv:2509.13021 v1, Sec 4.1). Five core components. The Action Executor runs commands against the target (ingests attacker-controlled banners/responses); the Information Aggregator is the phase hand-off that consolidates completed-phase outputs (attacker-origin text) into directives for the next phase -- the headline checkpoint site. The Task Orchestrator builds/updates the Task Coordination Graph and is the critical coordinating component.
source: xOffense, arXiv:2509.13021 v1, Section 4.1 (core components) + 4.2 (phase agents)

edges.source: Sec 4.1: Command Synthesizer -> Action Executor (tool commands)
Sec 4.1: Action Executor -> Task Orchestrator (filtered insights/feedback)
Sec 4.1: Knowledge Repository stores task results (ingests tool outputs)
Sec 4.1: Information Aggregator consolidates completed-phase outputs
Sec 4.1: Knowledge Repository -> Task Orchestrator (top-k retrieved cases)
Sec 4.1: Information Aggregator -> next-phase planner (Task Orchestrator)
Sec 4.1: Task Orchestrator -> Command Synthesizer (task directives)
